title: Act: Extract render constant and add autoRound in buildGameConfig
description: Edit config.ts so render settings come from an exported constant and scale has autoRound true.
acceptance_criteria: render equals the constant with pixelArt, roundPixels true and antialias false
technical_constraints: Only Phaser.AUTO, Phaser.Scale.FIT, Phaser.Scale.CENTER_BOTH referenced from phaser

steps.action: Add an exported constant PIXEL_ART_RENDER with pixelArt true, roundPixels true, antialias false, typed as Phaser.Types.Core.RenderConfig.
steps.code: export const PIXEL_ART_RENDER: Phaser.Types.Core.RenderConfig = { pixelArt: true, roundPixels: true, antialias: false };

steps.action: Replace the inline render object with a spread of PIXEL_ART_RENDER and add autoRound: true to the scale object.
steps.code: render: { ...PIXEL_ART_RENDER }, scale: { mode: Phaser.Scale.FIT, autoCenter: Phaser.Scale.CENTER_BOTH, autoRound: true }
steps.expected: Returned config has render keys and scale.autoRound true
